Alex (Sales): Quick heads-upwe're kicking off a POC with Contoso next week. They require strict EU-only data residency: all request/response payloads, logs, metrics must remain inside eu-west-1. Can we confirm options?
Meera (SE): For POC the recommended path is Dedicated in eu-west-1 with region pinning. Hosted can be configured to prefer EU but control-plane metadata (billing/identity) may touch our central control plane in us-east by default.
Jordan (PM): Is there a supported config to force 'EU-only' routing and make requests fail if capacity isn't available (rather than silently falling back)?
Meera (SE): Yes. We have a routing_policy you can set to "strict" with allowed_regions=["eu-west-1"] and fallback=null. Behavior: if no capacity, requests error out with 429/503 depending on the condition. We'll surface the error so app can degrade gracefully.
Alex (Sales): Contoso also asked about sub-processors and whether any 3rd-party monitoring or logging sends data outside EU for Dedicated.
Heather (CISO): Short answer: for Dedicated deployed in eu-west-1, infra and logs can stay in EU. Standard Hosted uses some managed services in US for analytics; Datadog and Sentry are opt-in. We can provide an EU-only stack for logs/monitoring, and a DPA + SOW clause for data residency.
Gita (Eng): For Dedicated we can enable in-region KMS and run logging/metrics stacks in eu-west-1. Customer-managed KMS (AWS CMK) supported. For Private on-prem, you control keys and telemetry egress (zero outbound required).
Alex (Sales): They asked for a concrete network allowlist for their security team.
Gita (Eng): Example placeholder CIDRs for Dedicated eu-west-1 (final list will be published): 3.120.0.0/12, 18.194.0.0/15. Only TCP/443 outbound required for API traffic. For bootstrap we may need SSH (port 22) from our deployers; can disable post-deploy. We'll deliver a canonical JSON snippet for infra teams.
Jordan (PM): Can you paste that snippet here so I can forward to Contoso's infra?
Meera (SE): Putting a minimal sample they can paste into their request:
```json
{
  "deployment_type": "dedicated",
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "routing_policy": {
    "mode": "strict",
    "allowed_regions": ["eu-west-1"],
    "fallback": null
  },
  "kms": {
    "mode": "customer_managed",
    "provider": "aws",
    "region": "eu-west-1"
  }
}
```
Alex (Sales): Perfect. Pricing impact? Contoso expects Hosted POC credits but residency forces Dedicated; what's the guidance?
Meera (SE): Dedicated has a monthly reservation minimum + usage. For short POC we can do a small reserved capacity trial (2 weeks) or a managed POC quote. Private/on-prem is quoted separately (one-time infra + support). I'll capture rough numbers in the POC doc but AE should provide firm quote.
Heather (CISO): Also flag: SOC2 and EU DPA asked by Contoso. We'll attach certs and DPA template to the ticket. If they need contractual guarantees about metadata not leaving EU, we'll need an addendum and may require Dedicated or Private.
Alex (Sales): Any enterprise blockers we should surface now (SLA, logs retention, export controls)?
Meera (SE): SLA: Dedicated supports 99.9% regional with optional cross-region failover (but cross-region failover implies data movement; customers with strict residency typically opt out). Logs retention default 90 days; extended retention via contract.
Gita (Eng): One technical note: even with strict-region routing, some control-plane signals (billing identifiers, anonymized usage counters) may be processed in control plane endpoints. For strict legal residency we should propose Private or explicit contract language that limits metadata transfer and redacts fields.
Alex (Sales): Contoso asked whether we can support customer-managed HSM or BYOK in-region.
Gita (Eng): Yes. Supported: AWS KMS CMK in eu-west-1 for Dedicated; BYOK/HSM integrations available for Private air-gapped installs (requires legal + provisioning lead time).
Alex (Sales): I'll summarize and propose kickoff next Wed. Meera, can you prepare a 1-page POC checklist: infra reqs, sample routing snippet, sub-processor summary, and a pricing ballpark?
Meera (SE): On it. I'll upload artifacts to the ticket and draft the checklist.
deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-5048: "Contoso POC 024 - EU residency" assigned to @Gita (Eng).
Meera (SE): Also adding action: confirm whether Contoso needs Datadog/Sentry integrations (we can disable) and whether they require IP allowlist vs. FQDN-based egress.
Alex (Sales): Route docs to me first, then I'll loop legal/infra. Thanks all :thumbsup:
